channel.title: Google Antigravity — Changelog
channel.description: Release notes and changelog for Google Antigravity, minted by feedmint.

item.title: Artifact heading outline, print-mode commands, artifact alerts/carousels, improved terminal hyperlinks, and extensive CLI fixes
item.description: Artifact outline viewer navigation, print-mode read-only slash commands, machine-readable output formodelsandagents, alert callout and carousel rendering in markdown artifacts, terminal hyperlink improvements, and fixes for headless--mode, startup diagnostics, subagent messaging, and quota reporting.

item.title: Reliability, Performance Gains, and User Experience Polish
item.description: Antigravity 2.7.1 introduces visual side-by-side previews for image diffs alongside comprehensive screen-reader and keyboard accessibility enhancements. This update also delivers key performance boosts, bug fixes, and UX refinements across chat interactions and project navigation.

item.title: Vim modal editing mode, Vim-aware submission, print-mode slash-command enhancements, and various CLI and permission fixes
item.description: Vim modal editing mode with Normal, Insert, Visual, and Visual Line modes, Vim-aware prompt submission, Vim editing in comment/diff views, print-mode slash-command and non-interactive enhancements, plugin configuration improvements, and fixes for command auto-approval, MCP servers, and autocomplete history.

item.title: Faster long conversations, more reliable hooks and subagents
item.description: Conversations with long histories now open faster, improved custom hooks and subagents behavior, and administrator policies for connected tool servers are applied correctly — plus a broad set of fixes across chat, comments and the file viewer.

item.title: Prioritized inference tiers, real-time token usage streaming, and context-aware hook decorators
item.description: The 0.1.10 release introduces support for Gemini Prioritized Inference service tiers, real-time token usage event streaming, stateful context-aware hook decorators, and explicit tool call correlation IDs across hook callbacks. It also standardizes default system instruction merging behavior, fixes WebSocket compaction events, and expands local Gemma model documentation.

item.title: Gemini Enterprise & WIF authentication, read-only .git sandbox rules, hook ordering improvements, and subagent and CLI fixes
item.description: Gemini Enterprise Business sign-in, Workforce Identity Federation (WIF) and Application Default Credentials (ADC) auth support, read-only.gitsandbox access, hook ordering improvements, and fixes for subagent tree termination,--model/--effortflag resolution, and multi-select spacebar toggling.

item.title: Slash-command expansion in print mode, non-blocking MCP startup, session-wide permission memory, system temp directory write grants, and hook and UI stability fixes
item.description: Added slash-command and skill expansion in print mode, non-blocking background MCP loading during interactive startup, session-scoped permission pattern recording, system temporary directory write grants, and stability fixes for stop/PostToolUse hooks, artifact viewer, and MCP authentication.

item.title: Enterprise sign-in: Gemini Enterprise accounts and Workforce Identity Federation
item.description: Added enterprise sign-in support for Gemini Enterprise user accounts (with admin controls) and Workforce Identity Federation via Advanced SSO.

item.title: Print mode structured output formats, custom JSON schema enforcement, copyOnSelect TUI setting, and compound-command permission improvements
item.description: Added structured output formats (json,stream-json) for print mode, support for custom JSON schema validation, enriched tool and subagent payloads,copyOnSelectconfiguration setting, and improved compound-command permission rules.

item.title: Preview tabs, MCP timeouts, file attachments, and performance fixes
item.description: Added preview tabs, attachment support for .json, .md, and .csv files, MCP timeouts, keyboard shortcuts, and various bug fixes and improvements.

item.title: Model-call retry/backoff configuration, LiteRT warm-up scaling, and tool execution error handling
item.description: Release 0.1.9 of the Google Antigravity Python SDK adds model-call retry/backoff configuration, improves tool registration for custom functions, adds missingBuiltinToolsexports, fixes user audio payload processing, and adds connectionDebugConfigsupport along withToolExecutionErrorhandling.

item.title: Markdown format custom agents, /copy index support, progressive /codesearch streaming, default temp directory access, and stability fixes
item.description: Added support for defining custom agents in Markdown format (agent.md), optional index argument for/copy, progressive streaming in/codesearch, default read access to system temporary directory, and resolved various TUI jitter, artifact viewer, and sandbox fixes.

item.title: Permission prompts for compound commands, and fixes for disabled plugins, MCP OAuth, and clipboard corruption
item.description: Improved permission prompts for compound shell commands, and fixed disabled plugins running hooks, MCP OAuth issuer validation, CJK clipboard copying on Windows, and/btwerror on startup.

item.title: Gemini 3.6 Flash default model, custom subagent instructions, and Pydantic argument coercion
item.description: Release 0.1.8 of the Google Antigravity Python SDK updates the default text model to Gemini 3.6 Flash, adds support for custom subagent instructions, and implements automatic Pydantic argument coercion for tool calls. It also brings defensive prompt sanitization, configurable tool retries, and comprehensive stability improvements for local agent execution.

item.title: Reasoning effort command, model slug pinning, subagent model configuration, and TUI stability improvements
item.description: Added/effortcommand and--effortflag for reasoning effort selection, stable model slugs, subagent model config, redesigned/modelpicker, scrollable/settingspanel, and various MCP and background task fixes.

item.title: Slash command chaining, diff scrolling fixes, and headless policy enforcement
item.description: Added slash command stacking (chaining multiple commands in a single prompt), diff viewer scroll fixes, headless mode settings.json policy enforcement, and subagent declaration fixes.

item.title: Codesearch command, copy-on-select, and performance optimizations
item.description: New/codesearchcommand for regex workspace searches, copy-on-select, async skill discovery, and stability fixes.

item.title: Startup stability fix
item.description: Fixes a bug where an empty or malformed configuration file caused AGY to fail to load on startup.

item.title: Multi-threaded state handling, subprocess isolation, extra high thinking, and local model MCP
item.description: Release 0.1.7 of the Google Antigravity Python SDK expands end-user control over agent execution environments, strengthens concurrency safety for stateful tools, and introduces deeper reasoning capabilities. Key highlights include atomic multi-threaded state handling for tools and hooks, customizable subprocess environment variable isolation, support for an "extra_high" thinking severity level, and full Model Context Protocol (MCP) and subagent support across local model backends. This release also resolves interactive console prompt clobbering and improves socket discovery under containerized setups.

item.title: Full diff preview, OAuth print mode improvements, and lag fixes
item.description: Added full-screen diffs for file creations, OAuth authorization code pasting in print mode, and 5000+ step latency optimizations.

item.title: Queued messages, plain text files support, and stability improvements
item.description: Added support for queued messages, settings to configure message execution, a send now option, plain text file attachments, and various bug fixes and improvements.

item.title: Custom agents flag, in-file keyword search, and Jujutsu diff fixes
item.description: Added--agentflag, in-file keyword search for artifacts, recursive subagent updates, and Jujutsu workspace diff fixes.

item.title: LiteRT model configurations, dynamic GCP environment hydration, and performance updates
item.description: This release expands local execution capabilities by broadening support for multimodal and web-connected tool workflows. Developers can now run Gemma models locally using LiteRT or integrate with local OpenAI-compatible APIs, natively return multimodal media from custom tools, and leverage a more robust, streamlined lifecycle hooks framework that is fully aligned with Model Context Protocol (MCP) workflows.

item.title: Request-review mode, execution mode cycling, and line-level diff previews
item.description: Public release of mode cycling, default request-review mode with interactive line-level diff previews, and settings panel integration.

item.title: Streaming task logs, model generation retries, and markdown subagents
item.description: Auto-scrolling background task logs, automatic client-side generation retries, and markdown-based dynamic subagents.

item.title: Subagent & task status bar, editor warnings, and Windows fixes
item.description: New interactive status bar for subagents and background tasks, clipboard image pasting improvements, and Windows fixes.

item.title: Indefinite goals, subagent auto-approvals, and plugin fixes
item.description: Indefinite goals support, subagent auto-approval mode for artifacts, and directory preservation during plugin imports.

item.title: Optimistic slash commands, strict permission matching, and multiline undo
item.description: Optimistic slash command rendering, strict non-regex permission matching, and unified undo/redo prompt history.

item.title: Streaming tool calls, custom subagent delegates, and thread safety enhancements
item.description: This release introduces native OpenTelemetry tracing support, declarative subagent configurations, improved type safety, and critical robustness and compatibility updates.

item.title: Antigravity Guide, audio support, search improvements, and performance fixes
item.description: New built-in Antigravity Guide skill, audio file rendering, improved substring file search, performance optimizations, and critical bug fixes.

item.title: Ctrl+C interrupt flow, persistent resume cache, and AltScreen tool review
item.description: Addedctrl+cinterrupt and exit handling, parallel/resumemetadata caching, and expanded AltScreen tool confirmations.

item.title: Project launch flags, terminal hyperlinks, and shift+n diff cycling
item.description: Added--projectlaunch flags, dynamic OSC8 terminal hyperlinks, reverse diff cycling, and permission priorities.

item.title: Model quota screen and agent security fixes
item.description: New model quota screen, agent permission and security fixes, and MCP stability improvements

item.title: ARM64 device support, builtin guide skill, and ASCII node graphs
item.description: Expanded ARM64 device compatibility, added builtinantigravity_guideskill, and enabled ASCII Git log graphs.

item.title: Async tool execution buffers, memory state persistence, and error handling improvements
item.description: This release introduces major architectural refactorings, public API standardizations, and key new capabilities centered on centralizing model configurations to natively support multi-model backends, exposing a new built-in Google Web Search capability, enabling environment variable passing for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and simplifying the agent initialization flow by removing dynamic runtime registrations.

item.title: Git submodule plugins, read-only permissions, and sandbox hardening
item.description: Automatic Git submodule resolution for plugins, read-only access for builtin skills, and sandbox path hardening.

item.title: Slash command history, Models & Quota page, and TUI performance
item.description: Replay slash command history with Up arrow, redesigned Models & Quota page, and statusline quota usage indicators.

item.title: Initial subagent orchestration and standard Google AI model targets
item.description: This release introduces per-server MCP timeout configurations and improves local connection error handling.

item.title: Quota Screen Redesign and PDF Support
item.description: Quota screen redesign, PDF attachment support, new /btw slash command, and other bug fixes

item.title: Configurable MCP timeouts, artifact gutter line mapping, and Wayland clipboard
item.description: Configurable MCP server connection timeouts, accurate line-numbered artifact gutters, and native Wayland clipboard support.

item.title: Path auto-completion, optimistic prompt rendering, and fuzzy matching
item.description: Path autocompletion for/openand/add-dir, optimistic chat prompt rendering, and fuzzy slash command matching.

item.title: Google Antigravity SDK release 0.1.2 updates
item.description: This release adds Windows platform support, introduces programmatic turn-level stream cancellation, simplifies safety policy configurations for the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and removes the deprecated MCP SSE transport.

item.title: Model selection flags, in-CLI permissions editor, and URL MCP servers
item.description: Added--modellaunch flag, interactive/permissionseditor, and URL-configured MCP servers.

item.description: This release focuses on significant enhancements to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration, adds native Vertex AI authentication support, improves robustness with better error handling, and includes critical fixes for token usage tracking.
